_comment: VizQL Data Service query against the Tableau Cloud published data source "Supplier's Availability Data" (LUID a7ab1f36-6a15-4c2c-8e7a-4ea0f74a1320). One row per supplier item, with per-store stock status pivoted into strings in store order Egaila|Hawally|Jahra|Salmiya|Qibla. Feed the JSON result to tools/build_snapshot.py.

fields.calculation: IFNULL(MAX(IF [Store]='Egaila' THEN (IF [Items in Stock]='Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) END),'-') + IFNULL(MAX(IF [Store]='Hawally' THEN (IF [Items in Stock]='Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) END),'-') + IFNULL(MAX(IF [Store]='Jahra' THEN (IF [Items in Stock]='Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) END),'-') + IFNULL(MAX(IF [Store]='Salmiya' THEN (IF [Items in Stock]='Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) END),'-') + IFNULL(MAX(IF [Store]='Qibla' THEN (IF [Items in Stock]='Yes' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) END),'-')

IFNULL(STR(INT(SUM(IF [Store]='Egaila' THEN [Current Stock] END))),'') + '|' + IFNULL(STR(INT(SUM(IF [Store]='Hawally' THEN [Current Stock] END))),'') + '|' + IFNULL(STR(INT(SUM(IF [Store]='Jahra' THEN [Current Stock] END))),'') + '|' + IFNULL(STR(INT(SUM(IF [Store]='Salmiya' THEN [Current Stock] END))),'') + '|' + IFNULL(STR(INT(SUM(IF [Store]='Qibla' THEN [Current Stock] END))),'')

IFNULL(STR(INT(SUM(IF [Store]='Egaila' THEN [Items in Book] END))),'') + '|' + IFNULL(STR(INT(SUM(IF [Store]='Hawally' THEN [Items in Book] END))),'') + '|' + IFNULL(STR(INT(SUM(IF [Store]='Jahra' THEN [Items in Book] END))),'') + '|' + IFNULL(STR(INT(SUM(IF [Store]='Salmiya' THEN [Items in Book] END))),'') + '|' + IFNULL(STR(INT(SUM(IF [Store]='Qibla' THEN [Items in Book] END))),'')
